headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham scored eight of his 18 points in the final 3:21, and the Detroit Pistons rallied to beat the Atlanta Hawks 99-98 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cunningham stars late as the Pistons hang on to beat the Hawks 99-98

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 43 points to lead the Cleveland Cavaliers to a 135-119 victory over the Indiana Pacers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell scores 43 points to lead Cavaliers to 135-119 win over Pacers

headlines.description: — CJ McCollum scored 28 points, including a 3-pointer with 14.4 seconds remaining that helped the Washington Wizards outlast the Milwaukee Bucks 129-126 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCollum and Middleton lead the Wizards to a 129-126 win over Milwaukee despite Porter's 30 points

headlines.description: — Michael Porter Jr. scored 35 points, Noah Clowney had 18 and the Brooklyn Nets beat the Charlotte Hornets 116-103 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porter scores 35 points as the Nets beat the Hornets 116-103

headlines.description: — Norman Powell scored 30 points against his former team, Bam Adebayo had 27 points and 14 rebounds in 32 minutes and the Miami Heat downed the reeling Los Angeles Clippers 140-123 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heat use 30-2 run to pull away, tie franchise record with 24 3-pointers, roll past Clippers 140-123

headlines.description: — Desmond Bane scored 18 of his 37 points in the fourth quarter, helping the Orlando Magic beat the Chicago Bulls 125-120 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bane's big 4th quarter helps the Magic beat the struggling Bulls 125-120

headlines.description: — Anthony Davis scored a season-high 32 points in his second game back from injury, and the Dallas Mavericks beat the Denver Nuggets 131-121 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Davis has 32 points as Mavericks beat Nuggets 131-121

headlines.description: — Lauri Markkanen scored 29 points and Keyonte George added 28 as the Utah Jazz outlasted the Houston Rockets 133-125 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Markkanen scores 29 and George adds 28 in bounce-back game as Jazz outlast Rockets 133-125

events.name: Phoenix Suns at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Dillon Brooks scored 33 points, Collin Gillespie added 16 of his career-high 28 in the fourth quarter, and the Phoenix Suns emphatically snapped the Los Angeles Lakers' seven-game winning streak with a 125-108 victory Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suns snap Lakers' 7-game winning streak with 125-108 victory despite Booker's early exit
